title: Map dead-space, lag, and Refine edges fixes
description:
Map Builder had a huge black dead-space box because the workspace floor was ~96 page-widths. That also forced tiny fit-zoom and made PDF re-rasters feel extremely laggy.

Workspace padding is back to a modest size. Refine edges cancel/apply no longer full-re-renders the board (that wiped canvases white). Edge bars bind their own pointer drag, and crop deltas keep sub-pixel precision while dragging.

Who is affected: PipeSync Map Building on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh PipeSync, then reopen the map workspace.
changeLog: Shrink Map workspace dead-space floor (was ~96 pages wide).
Cancel/Apply Refine edges without wiping sheets white.
Bind Refine edge bar drag directly on the blue bars.
Lower map PDF oversample and lengthen zoom repaint debounce for less lag.
